ability.afterCombat: If an opposing fighter is adjacent to a bee, deal 1 damage.

cards.body:
A stack of bees is 1 character until separated. If you attack with stack, add +1 to the cards value per bee (not counting the bottom bee). If a stack is attacked, damage is dealt to ONLY the bee on the top. If a card says to deal damage to a character, only the top bee takes the damage.

A boost value of  is equal to the number of bees in a stack. If you have multiple stacks, select the one you want.  Bob does not count as a stack.
cards.heading: Stack Rules

ability.plain: Choose a stack. Gain 1 action for every bee in the stack. If there is no available stack, revive 2 bees instead.
This card may not be played 2 times on the same turn.
ability.afterCombat: The stung player gets 1 less action their next turn.

abilities.name: The Stack
abilities.text:
When bees are revived, you must put them adjacent to Bob (or another bee if bob has no open spaces next to him.. When maneuvering, you can combine bees by moving the onto the same space. This forms a stack. You may take bees off the stack and move them separately. If no bee stacks are available, place a bee adjacent to Bob.

Bob cannot form a stack. Bob may play any Bee cards.
